verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a built-in analytics capability that tracks search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality and spot improvement opportunities, which covers the click-through element and the general query-tracking need. The evidence never explicitly mentions top-query rankings or no-result/zero-hit query reporting, and there is no description of the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit top-queries and no-result-queries reports, dashboard/UI documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
